flowui_capabilities.description: Discover offline or selected-run capabilities and status.

flowui_context.description: Retrieve bounded library contracts and source selectors.

flowui_capture.description: Plan, start or stop a bounded evidence job.

flowui_job.description: Recover job progress or request bounded cancellation.

flowui_scenario.description: List or execute application-registered workloads in their declared mode.

flowui_query.description: Query retained performance, diagnostics, memory or visual evidence.

flowui_artifact.description: Read inventoried metadata/text or a bounded PNG image.

flowui_compare.description: Evaluate comparability and explicit pass/fail/inconclusive objectives.

flowui_changes_preview.description: Review typed tooling changes with exact expected revisions.

flowui_changes_apply.description: Commit an explicitly selected revision-checked tooling transaction.

flowui_interaction.description: Discover, compile, execute or record finite frame-bound input plans. Start and recording operations acquire runtime control; planning and queries only read data.
